Obtaining the 13C NMR spectrum will allow me to infer which fragments (e.g., carbonyl carbon, aromatic carbons, methyl carbons) are present and how they might be connected. This single, inexpensive measurement should be sufficient to propose the fragment SMILES strings.</thought>
